entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hello, thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
I need to make a return.
I can certainly look into that for you. May I have your name and order number, please?
Sarah Miller. Order number is VF-881-C9.

Thank you, Sarah. One moment... Okay, I see your order for the VeloBand Pulse, delivered on December 29th. That makes it 18 days ago. To make sure I'm helping you correctly, could you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
It works fine. I just don't use it.
I see. So it sounds like you've just changed my mind about keeping it, is that right?
Yes. It was an impulse buy and it's just sitting here. I want my money back.

I appreciate the clarification. I've just reviewed the return eligibility, and the VeloBand Pulse has a specific 10-day return policy due to hygiene protocols and how the device links to a user's personal account upon activation. Since we're on day 18, I'm afraid it's outside the window for a refund.
Ten days. Of course it is. How convenient. Whatever.

I do understand this isn't the answer you were hoping for, Sarah. While I can't process a return, we do have another very popular option. We have an official VeloFit Resale Marketplace for situations just like this.
A 'resale marketplace'? What's that supposed to be?

It's our dedicated platform where customers can sell their gently used gear to other VeloFit users. Since you've barely used the Pulse, you can list it there and likely get most of your money back. It's a very active community.
So you're just telling me to sell it myself. Fine. Send me the link, I guess.
Of course. I am sending that email to you right now. It will have a direct link and a guide on how to create your listing. Is there anything else I can assist with today?
Alright. Well, thank you for calling VeloFit, Sarah. I hope you have a great day.
